svg.desc: A CTR model. Sparse categorical ids are hashed with a stable hash of field and value modulo n and looked up in an embedding table; dense counts are log-transformed and standardised. All vectors are concatenated into x0, which feeds a cross network and a deep MLP in parallel; their outputs are combined and passed through a sigmoid to give pCTR.

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: A CTR model: hashed embeddings + DCN-v2

svg.text: Sparse ids become vectors, a cross network learns feature crosses, a sigmoid gives pCTR.

svg.text: Almost all parameters live in the embedding table (93% in the notebook's model).

svg.text: Cross layer: x_{l+1} = x0 ⊙ (W x_l + b) + x_l. Each raises the interaction degree by one; + x_l keeps lower orders.

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Loss: log loss on clicks. Output bias starts at log(CTR / (1 − CTR)) ≈ −3.5 so the model is calibrated from step one.
